why: Every one of these scored buyer 1.00 on the first run against 753 real
adverts. They are pinned here as the rules that fixed them, so the fix
is a failing test rather than a comment somebody deletes.

cases.why: Black Canyon Consulting scored buyer 1.00 because `consulting` was in its NAME. Dropping the bare word demotes it to practitioner, which is correct: a company paying for Python and AWS work is market evidence, just not a lead.

record.text: BCC | Platform Systems Engineers | Bethesda MD | Competitive compensation! Black Canyon Consulting (BCC) is hiring Platform Systems Engineers of all levels to join our team at the National Center for Biotechnology Information. Python and AWS.

cases.why: `1099` matched a figure in a full-time advert. A tax form is only a tax form next to the word contractor.

record.text: SerpApi | Junior to Senior Fullstack Engineer | Based in our Austin office | Full-time only | We serve 1099 requests per second at peak. Python, Ruby, AI features. Salary $120k-160k.

cases.why: "on-site in Bremen | Full-Time" scored buyer 1.00 because onsite_only only carried the phrase "on-site only". It is now practitioner, and that is the right answer rather than a compromise: the company genuinely pays for AI workflow automation, it just will not do it as a remote contract. Market evidence, not a lead.

record.text: AREO | Engineering Manager, Lead Product Engineer | Remote (EU) / on-site in Bremen, Germany | Full-Time | Equity | We build AI workflow automation for robotics. Contract negotiable for the right person.

cases.why: "Fractional / Contract | Equity-only" is a perfect engagement line with no money behind it. Preferring adverts to forum posts is pointless if the advert has no budget.

record.text: Olli Technologies | Founding Engineer & Technical Lead | REMOTE (US) | Fractional / Contract | Equity-only (2-5%). We're building an AI-native operations platform with Python and LLM agents.

cases.why: A co-founder search is an equity-only role wearing a different title, and it reads as a contract opening because the words overlap.

record.text: Regnitive | Technical Co-Founder | Toronto, ON, Canada | Equity | Early-stage startup building AI-powered privacy and data governance. Consulting or freelance arrangement possible while we raise.

cases.why: The Freelancer thread is 23 of 23 people advertising themselves. If one lands in this collector it must be rejected outright, not scored.

record.text: SEEKING WORK | Remote | Python automation, API integrations, Excel and Google Sheets fixes. Fixed price agreed in writing before work starts. $80/hr or project rate.
